piezas.titulo: Listen: Register, audience and own voice
texto: Listening comprehension of masterclasses on sociolinguistics and the critique of public discourse: train yourself to identify how an experienced speaker moves from warm, colloquial Thai to administrative or academic Thai according to the profile of the listeners. When you hear «ใจความเดิมยังอยู่ แม้เปลี่ยนทำเนียบภาษา», notice the speaker's technical skill in disseminating complex concepts without vulgarising or distorting them.
